title: Show me nothing
hints: Try every small `n` by hand: 2, 1, 0. Which one gives a surprising result?
The sorting is fine; look at how the last `n` items are taken. A negative start index counts from the end, but there is no negative zero for `slice`: `-0` is just `0`, the very start of the array.
Only slice when there's something to take: `return n > 0 ? sorted.slice(-n) : [];`
